subject: Behavioral Economics
title: The Choice Architect's Role
description: A quick, practical guide to The Choice Architect's Role.

hook.text: A cafeteria manager places salads before fries. Salad sales jump 25%. She didn't remove fries. She moved them.

buildup.text: A choice architect designs the environment where people make decisions. Layout, order, and labels all matter.

discovery.text: Everyone who designs a form, menu, or webpage is a choice architect. The question is whether they're aware of it.

twist.text: There's no neutral design. Alphabetical order favors items starting with A. Random order is still an order.

climax.text: Good choice architecture makes the best option the easiest to reach. Bad architecture hides it behind friction.

punchline.text: If you design choices, you shape outcomes.

quiz.question: What does a choice architect do?
options: Removes all options except the best one
Designs the environment where decisions are made

details.summary: The choice architect is any person or system that designs the context in which people make decisions. From cafeteria managers to website designers to policymakers, choice architects shape behavior through the arrangement, defaults, and framing of available options.
details.whyItMatters: Understanding the role of the choice architect reveals that all design decisions influence behavior. A web form designer, a HR benefits coordinator, and a grocery store planner are all choice architects whose decisions shape thousands of choices.
takeaways: Anyone who designs a decision context is a choice architect
Choice architecture is never neutral; all designs favor some options over others
Responsible choice architects consider how their design influences behavior

faq.question: Who are the most influential choice architects in daily life?
faq.answer: Technology product designers who set default settings, HR administrators who design benefits enrollment, grocery store planners who arrange product placement, and government officials who design forms and processes. Each influences thousands of decisions through design choices.

faq.question: What responsibilities does a choice architect have?
faq.answer: To recognize that their design influences behavior, to consider what choice arrangement best serves the chooser, to set beneficial defaults, to simplify complex choices, and to be transparent about how their architecture shapes decisions.
